raw_fbx_parse_recipe.execution: Pure standard-library read-only binary inspection; did not import or invoke any Blender/Unreal module or generator.
raw_fbx_parse_recipe.inputs: Each FBX was read once as bytes; SHA256 and all mesh/colour witnesses derive from those same bytes.
raw_fbx_parse_recipe.reproducibility_limit: Current source module hashes are recorded; these are not signed producer attestations or proof that the exact current source bytes generated the already-existing FBX. The actual FBX witnesses remain authoritative for ingestion.
steps: Check Kaydara FBX Binary header; read little-endian version uint32 at byte 23.
Begin node records at byte 27. Use <IIIB node headers for FBX versions below 7500; <QQQB for 7500 and later.
Recursively decode nodes through absolute end offsets and null terminators. Decode scalar properties Y/C/I/F/D/L, raw/string R/S, and numeric arrays d/f/i/l/b/c.
For arrays read count/encoding/compressed-byte-length as three little-endian uint32 values; zlib-decompress when encoding is nonzero; unpack according to array type.
Collect Geometry headers, GlobalSettings/P unit+axis fields, Creator strings, Vertices arrays, PolygonVertexIndex arrays and Colors arrays.
For mesh bounds compute min/max of interleaved XYZ Vertices. A negative polygon index terminates each polygon; triangulated count is sum(polygon_vertex_count-2).
Group Colors into RGBA tuples, sort/deduplicate without colour-space conversion, and retain exact decoded float values.
Record authored UCX geometry headers if present. No UCX headers were present in these three files.
